viewer: Savers in their 40s parking safe retirement money for 20 years, weighing savings bonds guaranteed to double against rolling T-bills.
decision: Should I lock money in savings bonds that double in 20 years, or keep rolling T-bills instead?
promise: We roll T-bills through every 20-year stretch since the Depression to see how often they managed to double your money.
title: Savings Bonds That Double in 20 Years vs T-Bills
